question: Who won the Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2020 for a short documentary on honey hunting?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kezang D Thongdok.**____**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Kezang D. Thongdok of Arunachal Pradesh won the Dada Saheb Phalke Award 2020 for his short documentary "Chi Lupo."
 
• He also won best Editor Award ( Documentary) at 9th Kolkata shorts International Film festival-2020.
 
• A brief documentary on honey hunting is what Chi Lupo is about. Chi Lupo, where "Chi" stands for honey and "Lipo" for hunters, depicts the honey hunting customs practiced in the Shertukpen village.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Dheeraj Dhoopar:

 
 
• He is a well known Indian actor and a model, best known for his shows 'Sasural simar ka' and 'Kundali Bhagya'. 
 
 
 
• Armaan Malik:
 
 
• Indian singer, songwriter, record producer, voice-over artist, performer, dancer, Armaan Malik is also an actor. He is renowned for his multilingual singing.
 
 
 
• Kiccha Sudeep:
 
 
• He is an Indian actor who primarily appears in Kannada-language movies. He is also a director, producer, screenwriter, and television host.
